LSJ:

What's the precise meaning of 'since your last turn' irt Compel
the Spirit? (restore an ally/retainer burned since your last turn).

I.e., if Mehemet of the ahl-i-Batin gets burned during my minion phase
(got blocked and pounded), must I Compel him to return during that same
minion phase, or can I do it my next turn? I'm a little unclear if the
wording means 'since the beginning of your last turn' or 'since the end
of your last turn.'

cheers,

gomi

If those are the choices - it fits with 'since the end of your last turn'.
